findings.text: non-blocking: the two git config writes run through a raw subprocess.run with a hand-built CrewError instead of the module's own _git helper at reckon/crew/routing.py:543, which already wraps velocity.run_git, decodes output and raises the module's error shape, so this adds a second invocation convention to one module and loses the 180-second timeout the wrapper applies.

non-blocking: the four assertions at lines 117-121 compare the test's own stat record before and after its own os.utime call, so they cannot fail on any regression in routing.py and prove only the control's premise; they are fixture preconditions rather than guards, and the file's coverage of the change rests on lines 89, 92, 93 and 124 alone.
